turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I’m Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we’ll discuss your upcoming surgery to ensure everything goes smoothly. Can you tell me about your current condition?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, Doctor. I’ve been having pain in my tummy, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, so they decided to remove the gallbladder laparoscopically. It’s been bothering me for months lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Let’s go through your medications. What are you currently taking?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I take Amlodipine 10 mg every day for blood pressure, Atorvastatin 20 mg for cholesterol, and Omeprazole 20 mg for my acid reflux. Oh, and I stopped Lisinopril last week as instructed.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Any allergies we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I’m allergic to penicillin. Had a bad rash from it once.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Do you have any other allergies, particularly to sulfa-containing medications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Oh, right! I also can’t take sulfa drugs. Took one for a infection before and broke out in hives. Forgot to mention that earlier.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying. Have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, Doctor. I stopped eating after 8 PM last night as instructed. Just sipped some water for my morning meds.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Have you had anesthesia before? Any reactions to it?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, this is my first time. I’ve only had local anesthesia for minor things before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright. How’s your overall energy and activity level? Can you walk or climb stairs without difficulty?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I’m pretty active, Doctor. I walk daily and can climb stairs without problems. The pain from the gallstones is the main issue now.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. We’ll proceed with general anesthesia and intubation as planned. I’ll note your allergies and medication changes. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, Doctor. I think that’s all. Thank you for explaining everything.
